subject: E-1322: crash on launch on Android
body:
Hello support team. We run SyncVault 4.2.2 on Android 15 (Pixel 8). Since last week, every time I log in, I get 'E-1322: application crashed on launch'.

The vendor updater installed a fresh graphics driver. A fix for that driver is mentioned in the latest release notes.

I've already tried rebooting the router, which changed nothing.

Thanks, Daniel Ortega (Northbank Studio)
